_comment: Copy this file to lightning-accounts.json (gitignored) and fill one block per Lightning account. id = any unique slug. userId/apiKey from lightning.ai → Settings → Keys → Programmatic login. studioName/teamspace/user come from the Studio URL: lightning.ai/<user>/<teamspace>/studios/<studioName>. machine defaults to L4. monthlyBudgetHours = GPU-hours to spend before rotating (keep under ~21 that $15 buys; 18 leaves a buffer). cycleAnchorDay = day-of-month the free credit resets (your signup day).
label: my-first-account
